definitions.explanation: The separation of work processes into distinct tasks performed by different people or groups.

examples.japanese: {分業|ぶんぎょう}で{効率|こうりつ}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To increase efficiency through division of labor.

examples.japanese: {家事|かじ}を{分業|ぶんぎょう}している。
{国際|こくさい}{分業|ぶんぎょう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: International division of labor is advancing.

notes:
{分業|ぶんぎょう} refers to splitting work into specialized tasks performed by different people or groups. It can describe anything from household chore-sharing to global economic specialization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}する: to divide labor
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}{体制|たいせい}: division of labor system
- {国際|こくさい}{分業|ぶんぎょう}: international division of labor
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}{化|か}: specialization (the process of dividing labor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {役割|やくわり}{分担|ぶんたん}: division of roles (focuses on assigning specific roles)
- {協業|きょうぎょう}: collaboration, cooperative work (emphasizes working together rather than dividing)
- {専門|せんもん}{化|か}: specialization (focuses on developing expertise in one area)
